title: Run an enterprise pilot
summary: Plan an enterprise pilot around architecture review, security review, training, evidence, and fail-closed operational runbooks.

steps.title: Review enterprise architecture and controls
steps.detail: Use the enterprise docs as the source of truth for pilot scope, control ownership, and evidence.

steps.title: Assign accountable owners
steps.detail: Name platform, security, operator, auditor, and change-management owners before enabling production-adjacent capabilities.

steps.title: Run the pilot gates
steps.detail: Exercise training, failure runbooks, evidence review, and release qualification against an exact head before promotion.
